title: Introduce provider-neutral tool schema definitions
description: The current fenced text tool-call protocol is useful as a universal fallback, but the core should also expose provider-neutral tool definitions with JSON-schema-like input schemas so adapters can eventually render native Anthropic/OpenAI/Bedrock tool calls.
acceptance_criteria:
- ToolDefinition includes name, description, and input schema.
- Existing fenced text tool protocol remains supported.
- Tool registry can expose schema metadata.
- No provider-specific tool assumptions leak into core.
- Tests verify schema metadata for default tools.
